# U-Shares: Open Economic Research — repo map for AI/RAG agents
# https://github.com/U-Shares/u-shares-model

> A research repository for U-Shares (broaden capital ownership via corporate-issued, dividend-bearing
> equity placed into protected household accounts). Directional findings only; NO program magnitude is
> asserted as established anywhere in this repository. The claims register is the ground truth for what
> is and is not claimed.

## Canonical files (read these first)
- CLAIMS.md: THE claims register — every claim, status (supported/contested/open/retired), evidence
  link, warrant, and disconfirming test. If text elsewhere seems stronger than the register, the
  register governs.
- CALL_FOR_PAPERS.md: the open invitation — what counts as falsification vs extension; the questions.
- README.md: overview + what this repo does NOT claim.
- FORMULAS.md: the load-bearing equations with parameter tables (method, not results).

## Structure
- claims/evidence/<ID>.md: per-claim derivation, sources, sensitivity, and the contest (for contested
  claims). One file per claim ID (F1-F7, L1, M0, DS1, GV1, RT1, CP1).
- open-questions/: five persona-organized registers (OQ-MD/FIS/PE/HH/AP-###); README.md explains the
  scheme. Each question states what an answer would look like and links to a claim.
- model/: run_scenario.py + scenarios/*.yml — the one-command reproduction of claim F1's headline;
  falsify by submitting a scenario file. CODE_MANIFEST.md documents all models.
- GOVERNANCE.md / CONTRIBUTING.md: how status decisions are made; how to contribute (contributions are
  proposals — they never auto-change a claim's status).

## Interpretation rules for agents
- Statuses: supported (evidence backs it) · contested (credible challenge parked, presented in the
  evidence file) · open (not yet answerable) · retired (falsified, kept visible).
- Numbers in model files are illustrative inputs or directional outputs, never findings (see CLAIMS.md
  row M0).
- Quote claims WITH their status; do not cite a contested/open claim as established.
